Original Practice Question (not PYQ) — Linear Arrangements, Puzzle 1, Question 1.
Eight people A-H stand in a single row facing north. Positions are counted from the left. Clues: G occupies position 5 from the left. B occupies position 3 from the left. H occupies position 4 from the left. D occupies position 1 from the left. F occupies position 2 from the left. E occupies position 7 from the left. A occupies position 8 from the left.

Who stands 5th from the left?
entries.explanation: Exhaustive checking gives the unique left-to-right order D, F, B, H, G, C, E, A. Therefore who stands 5th from the left is G.
entries.source: Original Practice Question (not PYQ); generated and exhaustively checked for Banking Clerk practice. Group 1, question 1.
clues: G occupies position 5 from the left.
B occupies position 3 from the left.
H occupies position 4 from the left.
D occupies position 1 from the left.
F occupies position 2 from the left.
E occupies position 7 from the left.
A occupies position 8 from the left.
